verdict.rationale: Neon documents native pgvector extension support, allowing embeddings storage and vector similarity search directly in Postgres without a separate vector DB (neon-docs-15/32). This is first-party docs only, without independent hands-on benchmarks of vector search performance. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of pgvector performance at scale on Neon, and details on index types (HNSW/IVFFlat) support depth.
